description: This PHP source file defines the 'SugarFieldText' class, a subclass of 'SugarFieldBase', which handles the rendering and setup of text fields within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for generating detail view smarty templates, classic edit views, and configuring TinyMCE rich text editor integration based on user preferences and context.

classes.name: SugarFieldText
classes.description: Class handling text field rendering and editing in SuiteCRM, including support for rich text and TinyMCE integration.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares display parameters and calls parent method to render the detail view template for a text field.

methods.name: getClassicEditView
methods.description: Prepares and returns the HTML for the classic edit view of a text field, with support for rich text editor dimensions based on user preferences.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes field parameters, configuring TinyMCE if in HTML editor mode and during form editing actions.
